# Checkpoint A Review: Grouped Evaluation of Six Graph Instances

This read-only Checkpoint A review evaluates six concrete graph objects constructed via full-neighborhood extension on the immutable degree-54 source $G_{56862}$ ($n=56862, m=1535274$):
1. **$U_6$ instance:** $(56, 3)$ graph of order $57834$.
2. **$U_{10}$ family (5 endpoints):**
   - $k=1$: $(55, 3)$ graph of order $57672$
   - $k=2$: $(56, 3)$ graph of order $58482$
   - $k=3$: $(57, 3)$ graph of order $59292$
   - $k=4$: $(58, 3)$ graph of order $60102$
   - $k=5$: $(59, 3)$ graph of order $60912$

---

## 1. Mathematical Architecture & Typed Definitions

Both constructions instantiate the generic framework [`FullNeighborhoodClones.graph`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/formal/DegreeDiameter/Portfolio/FullNeighborhoodClones.lean) over the fixed source [`F9Graph56862.graph`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/formal/DegreeDiameter/Portfolio/F9Graph56862Linear.lean). New vertices connect strictly to the original source neighbors of their designated base centers; no new-new edges exist ($\text{Adj}(\text{inr } j_1, \text{inr } j_2) = \text{False}$).

### $U_6$ Instance (`F9SixFiberDouble56`)
- **Carrier & Labeling:** Vertex carrier is $\text{Fin } 56862 \oplus \text{Fin } 972$, with constructive equivalence [`label : Vertex \simeq Fin 57834`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/formal/DegreeDiameter/Portfolio/F9SixFiberDouble56Definitions.lean#L23). New index $j \in \text{Fin } 972$ decomposes as $j = 486 \cdot \text{copy} + 81 \cdot u + 9a + b$ with $\text{copy} \in \text{Fin } 2, u \in \text{Fin } 6, a, b \in \text{Fin } 9$.
- **Source Centers:** $U = [0, 1, 2, 3, 9, 15] \subset \text{Fin } 78$. The 486 base centers are parameterized by [`planeCenter`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/formal/DegreeDiameter/Portfolio/F9SixFiberDouble56Definitions.lean#L15) using the affine plane $W = \{(a, b, \eta a)\}$ with $\eta = c_4 \in \mathbb{F}_9$. In $\mathbb{F}_9 \cong \mathbb{F}_3[w]/(w^2+1)$, element code $4 = 1 + 3 \cdot 1$ corresponds strictly to field element $c_4 = 1+w$, not integer 4.
- **Center Immutability:** Both clone copies share the identical original source center [`center k = baseCenter (clonePair k).2`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/formal/DegreeDiameter/Portfolio/F9SixFiberDouble56Definitions.lean#L18-L19). Centers belong strictly to $G_{56862}$; adjacent centers are mathematically permissible because clones never link directly to one another.

### $U_{10}$ Family (`F9U10PlaneCloneFamily`)
- **Carrier & Labeling:** Parameterized carrier [`Vertex k = Fin 56862 \oplus (Fin k \times Fin 810)`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/formal/DegreeDiameter/Portfolio/F9U10PlaneCloneFamilyDefinitions.lean#L7), with explicit equivalence [`label k : Vertex k \simeq Fin (56862 + 810k)`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/formal/DegreeDiameter/Portfolio/F9U10PlaneCloneFamilyDefinitions.lean#L20-L21). Index $j = 810 \cdot \text{copy} + 81 \cdot u + 9a + b$ maps new vertices to $56862 + j$.
- **Index Roles:** $\text{Fin } 10$, $\text{Fin } 810$, and $\text{Fin } k$ serve purely as finite coordinate domains. Field arithmetic is confined to $\mathbb{F}_9$ (characteristic 3, negation $-t$, multiplication by $c_4 = 1+w$).
- **Fibers:** $U = [31, 32, 44, 45, 59, 60, 61, 72, 73, 74] \subset \text{Fin } 78$. The branch-and-bound optimization ($opt=10$) is selection history, not an assumed kernel premise.
- **Concrete Scope:** The kernel contains general parametric theorems for all $k$, but exactly five explicit concrete targets ([`concrete_55_57672`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/formal/DegreeDiameter/Portfolio/F9U10PlaneCloneFamilyExact.lean#L26) through [`concrete_59_60912`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/formal/DegreeDiameter/Portfolio/F9U10PlaneCloneFamilyExact.lean#L54)) and definitions ([`FinalClaim55`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/formal/DegreeDiameter/Portfolio/F9U10PlaneCloneFamilyExact.lean#L28) through [`FinalClaim59`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/formal/DegreeDiameter/Portfolio/F9U10PlaneCloneFamilyExact.lean#L56)) are declared and counted. Degree 60 ($k=6$, order $61722$) was excluded because PolarStarIQ $q=43, d=16$ provides an existing upper bound of $64362$.

---

## 2. Kernel Load Bounds & Injectivity Semantics

The degree bound for neighborhood cloning relies entirely on bounding $\text{load}(w) = |\{j \mid w \in N(c_j)\}|$.

1. **Affine Inversion Kernel:**
   [`sourcePlaneMap_injective`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/formal/DegreeDiameter/Portfolio/F9SixFiberDouble56Inputs.lean#L15-L23) establishes for any controller fiber $a \in \text{Fin } 78$ and port $p \in \text{Fin } 6$ that $x \mapsto \text{stepVec } a \, p \, (x_2) \, (\text{plane } x)$ is injective. It applies matrix action $M(\text{controller}(a,p), \text{invPort}(p))$ to cancel $T_u$, transports to the base chart at fiber 0 via $M(0,p)$, and delegates to the established single-plane kernel [`F9PlaneClone55.pinMap_injective`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/formal/DegreeDiameter/Portfolio/F9PlaneClone55Inputs.lean). No equality of charts between fiber $a$ and fiber 0 is assumed.

2. **Target Disjointness to Base Load:**
   [`common_plane_pin_index_unique`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/formal/DegreeDiameter/Portfolio/F9SixFiberDouble56Inputs.lean#L35-L55) requires solely that $(u, p) \mapsto \text{controller}(U[u], p)$ is injective.
   - For $U_6$: All $6 \times 6 = 36$ target controllers are pairwise distinct; [`controller_targets_injective`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/formal/DegreeDiameter/Portfolio/F9SixFiberDouble56Inputs.lean#L9-L10) is discharged by kernel decision. This yields [`base_load_le_one`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/formal/DegreeDiameter/Portfolio/F9SixFiberDouble56Inputs.lean#L63) ($\le 1$ for the 486 base centers).
   - For $U_{10}$: The 60 target controllers in $\text{Fin } 78$ are verified distinct via explicit 60-entry left inverse [`targetOwner`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/formal/DegreeDiameter/Portfolio/F9U10PlaneCloneFamilyInputs.lean#L8), kernel-verified in [`target_owner`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/formal/DegreeDiameter/Portfolio/F9U10PlaneCloneFamilyInputs.lean#L9-L10). Reusing `common_plane_pin_index_unique` directly proves [`base_load_le_one`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/formal/DegreeDiameter/Portfolio/F9U10PlaneCloneFamilyInputs.lean#L23) ($\le 1$ for the 810 base centers).

3. **Copy Load Projection:**
   Because each base center neighbor is unique, any center neighbor $j = (\text{copy}, \text{base})$ must have a fixed base index. The projection $j \mapsto \text{copy}$ is injective into $\text{Fin } 2$ for $U_6$ (giving [`load_le_two`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/formal/DegreeDiameter/Portfolio/F9SixFiberDouble56Inputs.lean#L68) $\le 2$) and into $\text{Fin } k$ for $U_{10}$ (giving [`copy_load_le`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/formal/DegreeDiameter/Portfolio/F9U10PlaneCloneFamilyInputs.lean#L28) $\le k$).
   Consequently:
   - $U_6$: maximum degree $\le 54 + 2 = 56$.
   - $U_{10}$: maximum degree $\le 54 + k$, giving degrees 55, 56, 57, 58, 59 for $k \in \{1, 2, 3, 4, 5\}$.

---

## 3. Formal Axiom Audits & Binding Integrity

- **Axiomatic Purity:**
  Inspection of the Lean environment logs confirms:
  - $U_6$ ([`F9SixFiberDouble56Exact.log`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/research/ddp/two_successful_methods_20261101/affine_field_conditions/r6_schreier78_controller/f9_degree54/six_fiber_double56_graph/formalization/F9SixFiberDouble56Exact.log)): [`concrete_order_degree_and_exact_D3`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/formal/DegreeDiameter/Portfolio/F9SixFiberDouble56Exact.lean#L21) and `final_claim` depend solely on the standard Lean axioms: `[propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]`.
  - $U_{10}$ ([`F9U10PlaneCloneFamilyExact.log`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/research/ddp/two_successful_methods_20261101/affine_field_conditions/r6_schreier78_controller/f9_degree54/u10_plane_clone_family/formalization/F9U10PlaneCloneFamilyExact.log) and [`F9U10PlaneCloneFamilyAudit.log`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/research/ddp/two_successful_methods_20261101/affine_field_conditions/r6_schreier78_controller/f9_degree54/u10_plane_clone_family/formalization/F9U10PlaneCloneFamilyAudit.log)): all five concrete theorems (`concrete_55_57672` to `concrete_59_60912`) and their companion `final_claim55` to `final_claim59` depend strictly on standard axioms `[propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]`. Zero unproven conjectures, custom axioms, or sorry instances exist.
- **Data Binding Architecture:**
  The Lean modules contain zero `#eval` calls on 12150 edge rows and specify no ASCII file parsers. Bridging from concrete edge files to formal definitions is established via:
  1. Formal symbolic theorems mapping $(copy, u, a, b)$ to explicit numeric integers (`label_new_coordinates`, `base_center_source_label`).
  2. Ground-truth recipe exports ([`FORMAL_ORDERED_CLONE_RECIPE.csv`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/research/ddp/two_successful_methods_20261101/affine_field_conditions/r6_schreier78_controller/f9_degree54/six_fiber_double56_graph/formalization/FORMAL_ORDERED_CLONE_RECIPE.csv) and [`FORMAL_ORDERED_CASE_RECIPE.csv`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/research/ddp/two_successful_methods_20261101/affine_field_conditions/r6_schreier78_controller/f9_degree54/u10_plane_clone_family/formalization/FORMAL_ORDERED_CASE_RECIPE.csv)).
  3. Pre-formal checks ([`INPUT_BINDING_CHECK.json`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/research/ddp/two_successful_methods_20261101/affine_field_conditions/r6_schreier78_controller/f9_degree54/u10_plane_clone_family/formalization/INPUT_BINDING_CHECK.json)) comparing the typed recipe rows against actual edge files and independent acceptance receipts by explicit $j$.

---

## 4. Independent Acceptance Status & Baseline Context

1. **Independent Verification Receipts:**
   - **$U_6$:** Preserves all 1535274 base edges; 52488 new edges; 0 new-new edges. Source loads: 30618 vertices at load 0, 26244 at load 2. All 972 new-root BFS runs match prediction $(1, 54, 2478, 55301)$ from source $R_2 = 2531$.
   - **$U_{10}$ Family (5 cases):** Preserves all 1535274 base edges across all five graphs. New-old edges: $43740 \cdot k$; 0 new-new edges. For each $k \in \{1..5\}$, exactly 43740 source vertices take load $k$ (degree $54+k$), while 13122 source vertices and all $810k$ new vertices retain degree 54. All 12150 aggregate new-root BFS runs exactly match predicted histogram $(1, 54, 2449+k, 54358+809k)$ derived from a single 810-source batch with $R_2 = 2449$.
2. **Public Baseline Guarantees:**
   The comparison targets for degrees 55–59 (56540, 57568, 58596, 59624, 60652) represent corollaries derived from published methods (Delorme spread/duality + matching replication on 12-truncated tetrahedra) rather than entries from an externally verified global record table. No uncertified global SOTA or priority claims are asserted.

---

## 5. Checkpoint A Verdicts

### Verdict for $U_6$ Instance ($(56, 3)$, order $57834$): **PASS**
- Typed carrier, label bijection, and center assignments are constructively closed in [`F9SixFiberDouble56Definitions.lean`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/formal/DegreeDiameter/Portfolio/F9SixFiberDouble56Definitions.lean).
- `sourcePlaneMap_injective` correctly handles the full Schreier lift inversion without chart-zero assumptions.
- Maximum degree $\le 56$, diameter $\le 3$, and $\neg(\text{diameter} \le 2)$ are unconditionally proven in [`F9SixFiberDouble56Exact.lean`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/formal/DegreeDiameter/Portfolio/F9SixFiberDouble56Exact.lean) with zero user premises (exit code 0).
- Independent acceptance verified all 1587762 literal edges and all 972 BFS trees.

### Verdict for $U_{10}$ Family (Five Endpoints, degrees $55$ to $59$): **PASS**
- Parameterized carrier $\text{Fin } 56862 \oplus (\text{Fin } k \times \text{Fin } 810)$ and bijections $\text{label } k$ are soundly typed in [`F9U10PlaneCloneFamilyDefinitions.lean`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/formal/DegreeDiameter/Portfolio/F9U10PlaneCloneFamilyDefinitions.lean).
- Disjointness of 60 controller targets is verified via the explicit `targetOwner` left-inverse table; base load $\le 1$ and copy load $\le k$ are proved without re-verifying underlying plane geometry.
- All five concrete declarations (`concrete_55_57672`, `concrete_56_58482`, `concrete_57_59292`, `concrete_58_60102`, `concrete_59_60912`) and their corresponding `FinalClaim` specifications in [`F9U10PlaneCloneFamilyExact.lean`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/formal/DegreeDiameter/Portfolio/F9U10PlaneCloneFamilyExact.lean) are fully proved with zero custom premises (exit code 0; audited in [`F9U10PlaneCloneFamilyAudit.log`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/research/ddp/two_successful_methods_20261101/affine_field_conditions/r6_schreier78_controller/f9_degree54/u10_plane_clone_family/formalization/F9U10PlaneCloneFamilyAudit.log)).
- Independent acceptance verified all five literal edgefiles and all 12150 BFS trees against prior $R_2$ predictions.
